entry.description: Refresh the projectsV2 item slug dadaia-workspace (kind library; LibraryProjectSchema in frontend/src/lib/schemas/projects.ts, mirrored in frontend/scripts/content-schema.mjs; assets in frontend/public/assets/projects/dadaia-workspace/) for dadaia-workspace 0.5.0 in pt, en and de, keeping parity. Today it states v0.1.5 and 'pip install dadaia-workspace'; PyPI is at 0.4.7. Base gap: that item, frontend/public/content/{pt,en,de}.json and content-schema.mjs exist only on origin/main (fcc8682); develop and feature/0.1.0 lack them, since main carries 3 squash commits (#28, #31, #32) develop does not, so the work starts by bringing main's state into the work branch. Copy facts come only from dadaia-workspace's README.md, docs/ and specs/memory/product/**: multi-harness workspace, SDD, the five roles, worktree pause/resume, dadaia export soft and --hard, init --from, the install line 'uvx dadaia-workspace init <dir> --harness <name>', the repo and PyPI links. Acceptance: (1) the content schema validates (npm run validate:content, schema:check); (2) npm run check:i18n-projects passes; (3) version 0.5.0, the uvx install line and the GitHub and PyPI links are correct in all three languages; (4) the copy states 0.5.0's features and every claim cites the dadaia-workspace source it comes from; (5) lint, typecheck, test:run, build and the CI SVG <= 50 KB gate are green; (6) stage is live after the merge to develop (deploy.yml deploy-stage); (7) the develop-to-main prod deploy runs, operator-approved, in dadaia-workspace rc-21 right before its promote, after which dadaia-workspace points its pyproject and GitHub homepage at the page.
entry.provenance: Operator, dadaia-workspace 0.5.0 roadmap grill 2026-10-18 (.dadaia/reports/dadaia-workspace/grill/roadmap-050.md): Q3 'Gate: page live first (Recommended)'; rc-20 Q1 'Revive now, parallel job (Recommended)'; rc-20 Q2 'specs init + one backlog lane (Recommended)'; foreign specs 'Yes, --replace-foreign (Recommended)'; main-thread timing ruling: stage live in rc-20, prod deploy in rc-21 right before the promote.
